description: Reference carry: turn 0 establishes a team; later turns refer back with 'that team' / 'they' / 'their'. Tests whether prior-turn conversation context lets the agent resolve the reference (vs a stateless single LLM that cannot).

turns.query: Which team finished top of the Premier League in the 2023-2024 season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_team FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND tss_rank = 1;

turns.query: How many goals did that team score across that season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_goals_for FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND tss_rank = 1;

turns.query: And who was their top scorer that season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_top_scorer_name, tss_top_scorer_goals FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND tss_rank = 1;
